admission.justification: Text occurrences, duplicate same-line names and undecodable unchanged blobs can otherwise look like unique/current proof definitions. Definition-aware occurrence preservation and honest refusal prevent false evidence while retaining a precise line-range alternative.

applicability: Citation/proof-symbol resolution in JavaScript-family test/spec source files and currentness observation of symbol anchors.
conditions: Plain it/test string titles bind nested describe-qualified names and bare titles; bare resolution is admitted only when its actual occurrence is unique, including duplicate occurrences on one line.
The semantic first argument ignores comment extras; plain JavaScript escapes and valid UTF-16 pairs decode while lone units remain represented. Non-test filenames do not gain test-case definitions.
Skipped, todo, each and computed title forms are not promoted to symbol definitions; the test-case diagnostic names unsupported forms and offers line_range recovery.
A non-UTF8 symbol source is unverifiable before the unchanged-blob fast path, names the path/UTF-8 reason and does not masquerade as a failed blob read.
exclusions: This adds no support for computed/parameterized/skipped/todo proof symbols, no fallback uniqueness from deduplicated same-line case spans and no arbitrary JavaScript execution.
The scope is source-defined extraction and classification; no parser suite, execution witness or first-class proof acceptance is inferred.
statement: Plain-string JavaScript and TypeScript test-case titles resolve as proof symbols with unique bare-title support, unsupported title forms are named with a line-range remedy, and invalid UTF-8 symbols are unverifiable.
